name: Psycho Mystery Series 'Innocent Noise'
original_name: サイコミステリー・シリーズ 「Innocent Noise」
source:
When a body was discovered in a library,  bludgeoned to death, Aida Mamoru, who was present at the scene, is accused of murder. Mishima Haruka, a female detective with the ability to see into the future, begins an investigation to clear Mamoru's name. However, this is only the beginning of a tragedy that is yet to unfold.

[Translated from [url=https://info.gmodecorp.com/gmodearchives/psychomystery/innocentnoise/]G-Mode official page[/url]]
translation:
当在图书馆发现一具被殴打致死的尸体时，当时在场的相田守被指控犯有谋杀罪。拥有预知未来能力的女侦探三岛遥开始调查，为阿卫洗清罪名。然而，这只是悲剧的开始，尚未上演。

[翻译自[url=https://info.gmodecorp.com/gmodearchives/psychomystery/innocentnoise/]G-Mode官方页面[/url]]
